_comment: Manual overrides for shows that APIs can't auto-pair. Key = any existing ID like kitsu_12345 or mal_12345. Value = full IDs to force. This file is checked FIRST before AniZip.
_how_to: 1. Open unmatched.csv 2. Find the show 3. Look up its IDs on anilist.co, myanimelist.net, anidb.net 4. Add entry here 5. Commit - next sync will use it
